title: Lost Student ID Card
content: Report a lost student ID card to the campus administrative office or the designated student services desk. Carry another valid form of identification if available and request a replacement through the official process.

title: Medical Assistance
content: For a non-emergency medical concern, contact the campus health centre or student welfare office. For urgent situations, contact the emergency services listed by your institution and seek immediate assistance from nearby staff.

title: Hostel Support
content: For hostel maintenance or accommodation issues, contact the hostel office or assigned warden and provide the room number and a short description of the issue.

title: Academic Office
content: For questions about course registration, academic records, certificates, or examination procedures, contact the appropriate academic or examination office.

title: Campus Emergency
content: During a campus emergency, move to a safe location, follow official campus instructions, and contact the institution's published emergency contacts or local emergency services as appropriate.
